mapper.sql: adv02_account_id AS account_id, adv02_company_id AS company_id, adv02_manage_cd AS manage_code, adv02_manage_nm AS manage_name, adv02_tr_corp_cd AS tr_corp_code, adv02_tr_corp_nm AS tr_corp_name, TO_DECRYPTS(adv02_account_no) AS account_no_dec, adv02_start_date AS start_date, adv02_close_date AS close_date, adv02_work_date AS work_date, adv02_worker AS worker
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adv02_account WHERE adv02_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND UPPER(CONCAT(adv02_manage_cd, adv02_manage_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{p.searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adv02_account (adv02_account_id, adv02_company_id, adv02_manage_cd, adv02_manage_nm, adv02_tr_corp_cd, adv02_tr_corp_nm, adv02_account_no, adv02_start_date, adv02_close_date, adv02_work_date, adv02_worker) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{r.manageCode}, #{r.manageName}, #{r.trCorpCode}, #{r.trCorpName}, TO_ENCRYPTS(#{r.accountNoDec}), #{r.startDate}, #{r.closeDate}, #{r.workDate}, #{r.worker})
mapper.update: UPDATE adv02_account SET adv02_manage_cd = #{r.manageCode}, adv02_manage_nm = #{r.manageName}, adv02_tr_corp_cd = #{r.trCorpCode}, adv02_tr_corp_nm = #{r.trCorpName}, adv02_account_no = TO_ENCRYPTS(#{r.accountNoDec}), adv02_start_date = #{r.startDate}, adv02_close_date = #{r.closeDate}, adv02_work_date = #{r.workDate}, adv02_worker = #{r.worker} WHERE adv02_account_id = #{r.accountId} AND adv02_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adv02_account (adv02_account_id, adv02_company_id, adv02_manage_cd, adv02_manage_nm, adv02_tr_corp_cd, adv02_tr_corp_nm, adv02_account_no, adv02_start_date, adv02_close_date, adv02_work_date, adv02_worker) VALUES (#{r.accountId}, #{r.companyId}, #{r.manageCode}, #{r.manageName}, #{r.trCorpCode}, #{r.trCorpName}, TO_ENCRYPTS(#{r.accountNoDec}), #{r.startDate}, #{r.closeDate}, #{r.workDate}, #{r.worker})
mapper.select: SELECT sys15_corp_cd FROM sys15_corp WHERE sys15_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys15_use_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys15_corp_type, '9') = '3' AND UPPER(sys15_corp_nm) = UPPER(#{corpName})
